search_observability_surface_label: Example State official voter-information search observability policy
delivery_role_note: Search-performance monitoring helps the office notice when current voter-information pages become harder to find, but it does not replace the current official page, notice, or office/help route as the rule source.

critical_query_cluster_set.task_note: Queries users issue when they need to confirm registration state or update records.
Queries that should land on the current official polling-place or vote-center lookup/help lane.
Queries for registration, absentee, early-voting, and ballot-return deadlines.

default_comparison_window_note: Routine reviews compare current movement against a recent period and against a longer seasonal window before a narrow drop is treated as a public-information failure.
preliminary_data_handling_note: Recent report points are treated as incomplete until the office confirms that the window is no longer in the preliminary-data range and that the timezone cutover has been understood.
anomaly_check_note: A product-side data-anomaly check is part of drop triage before a chart movement is treated as a real public discoverability incident.
ai_feature_measurement_note: AI-feature traffic is interpreted within the ordinary Web search measurement surface rather than as a separate hidden analytics system.
